description: Deterministic executable assertions for piecewise_linear; finite fixtures observe production outputs against independent masks or exact arithmetic. Passing is a finite evidence claim, not universal correctness.

inverse: All implementations producing the same finite assertion vector belong to one nonunique fiber. Original production and a mutant differing only on untested data may both pass; the compiled mutant (Increment interior rational denominator; affine reproduction assertion fails.) is separated by affine_exact. A pass vector cannot reconstruct source, runtime or behavior on unseen inputs.
limitations: Finite oracles do not establish universal accuracy
